JAPANESE FIRE POWER

LOOK: Japan Air Self-Defense Force personnel stand beside a Surface-to-Air-guided Missile for air base defence (Air Base Defence SAM) system during the Balikatan (“shoulder-to-shoulder”) exercise in San Antonio Zambales province on Tuesday, April 28.

The system consists of a Command Control System (CCS), a Fire Control System, (FCS), and a Launcher, which carries up to four guided missiles and is used to shoot down targets commanded from the Fire Control System.

Japan deployed "combat troops" to take part in the exercise – its first deployment of Japanese combat troops to the Philippines since 1945. | 📷: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer
